Yes, the appellate court will likely reverse. Under the prevailing modern view, felony murder doesn't cover the death of a co-felon. Most jurisdictions apply the agency theory, which attributes only the felons' own acts, and they also exclude co-felon victims, so a police officer's bullet that kills the woman can't support the charge. Some proximate-cause jurisdictions would allow liability for a death provoked by the felon, but even those generally refuse it when the victim is a co-felon. The man can still be convicted of armed robbery, assault, and similar offenses.

CONFIDENCE: 80
